services.name: Anthropic API (token-metered)
services.notes: Extrapolated from 6 days of paid invoices May 10-15 ($180.64 = $30.11/day). Auto-replenish triggered 2-3x/day on May 12-14. ~7.5x step-change from ~$115/mo baseline pre-2026-04-09 credit exhaustion. 78% of total LLM spend; primary target for attribution work in #296. Includes both Mac Claude Code and office2 OpenClaw traffic — not yet segmented (the dev-vs-felix split is what #296 unblocks). 2026-05-31 update: A second credit exhaustion occurred 2026-05-26 after the cap was raised $250 → $500 in May 2026. felix-doc-auditor identified as the dominant cost driver and suspended indefinitely (timer disabled + interpretation flags `enabled=false` + GH Actions workflows `disabled_manually`); reactivation gated on #137 cost-control work landing. The $30.11/day figure above is stale; June 2026 spend will drop substantially as a result of the suspension. Re-baseline once a stable post-suspension cost profile is established.
